title: Hydra
description: Every metric scraped out of Hydra's /queue-runner-status endpoint. The sections follow the JSON: queue totals, per machine, per system type, per jobset, and the runner's local store.

panels.title: Queued builds
panels.description: Builds still waiting to finish. One build can be many steps. (nrQueuedBuilds)

panels.title: ETA (all steps done)
panels.description: When the queue should be empty, if steps keep finishing at the rate measured over the last hour. Reads pessimistic right after a burst arrives and settles as the rate catches up.

panels.title: Backlog
panels.description: The same estimate as the ETA, written as hours of work left.

panels.title: Steps building now
panels.description: Steps running on a builder right now. (nrStepsBuilding)

panels.title: Unsupported steps
panels.description: Steps no builder can take, because no machine offers their system type. Anything above zero sits in the queue until you add a builder. (nrUnsupportedSteps)

panels.title: Highest retry count
panels.description: The most attempts any single step has needed so far. Climbs when builders start failing. (maxNrRetries)

panels.title: Effective parallelism
panels.description: How many steps run at the same time, on average: seconds of step time accumulated per second of wall-clock. 4 means four steps ran throughout.

panels.title: Average step time
panels.description: Average time from a step being dispatched to it finishing, including copying and waiting. Averaged since the runner started. (avgStepTime)

panels.title: Queue burndown
panels.description: How much work is left, and how far along it is: queued builds, unfinished steps, steps ready to run, steps running.

panels.title: Steps completed per minute
panels.description: Throughput against remaining work. The ETA is built on this rate, smoothed over an hour so it does not jump. (upstream: 'Hydra Jobs')

panels.title: Step pipeline
panels.description: Where the unfinished steps are right now. A tall copying band means the network between Hydra and its builders is the bottleneck, not the builders.

panels.title: Steps started vs finished
panels.description: If steps keep starting faster than they finish, work is accumulating inside the runner.

panels.title: Retries
panels.description: Steps Hydra had to run again after a failure. Usually the first visible sign that a builder has gone bad. (nrRetries, maxNrRetries)

panels.title: Average step time vs build time
panels.description: Both averaged since the runner started. The gap between the lines is everything that is not building: waiting for a free slot, copying inputs and outputs.

panels.title: Cumulative step time
panels.description: Total builder time spent since the runner started. The lower line is the part that was actual building. (totalStepTime, totalStepBuildTime)

panels.title: Builds read from the queue
panels.description: How fast the runner picks up new builds from the database, against how fast it retires them. (nrBuildsRead, nrBuildsDone)

panels.title: Queue read latency
panels.description: How long the runner takes to fetch one build from postgres. Rises when the database is under load. (buildReadTimeMs / nrBuildsRead)

panels.title: Current jobs per machine
panels.description: Steps running on each builder, stacked so the total is the pool's current load. (machines.*.currentJobs; upstream: 'Jobs per Machine')

panels.title: Steps completed per minute, per machine
panels.description: How much each builder is actually getting done. A builder that flatlines while the others keep going is the one to look at.

panels.title: Consecutive failures per machine
panels.description: Failures in a row on one builder; any success resets it to zero. A line that keeps climbing means the machine fails everything it is given. (machines.*.consecutiveFailures)

panels.title: Machine enabled
panels.description: 1 while Hydra is willing to send work to a builder, 0 once it has given up on it. (machines.*.enabled, classic runner only)

panels.title: Disabled builders (seconds until re-enable)
panels.description: Builders Hydra has taken out of rotation after repeated failures, and the seconds left until it tries them again. Empty is the healthy state. (machines.*.disabledUntil, classic runner only)

panels.title: Time since last failure
panels.description: How long each builder has gone without a failure. A builder that has never failed has no line. (machines.*.lastFailure, classic runner only)

panels.title: Average step time per machine
panels.description: Average step and build time per builder since the runner started. A machine well above the others is slow, overloaded, or building from a cold cache. (classic runner only)

panels.title: Machine busy time
panels.description: Seconds of work per second of wall-clock: 2.0 means two steps ran on this builder the whole time. Compare it with the machine's configured job slots to see spare capacity. The gap between step and build is time spent copying.

panels.title: Idle time per machine
panels.description: How long each builder has been sitting idle. Hydra only reports this while a machine is idle, so busy builders drop off the graph. (machines.*.idleSince)

panels.title: Steps done per machine (total)
panels.description: Steps each builder has finished since the runner started, i.e. the share of the load it carries. (machines.*.nrStepsDone)

panels.title: Runnable vs running per platform
panels.description: Steps ready to run against steps actually running, per system type. A runnable line that stays above the running line means you are short of builders for that platform.

panels.title: Queue wait pressure per platform
panels.description: Seconds of waiting accumulated per second of wall-clock, i.e. roughly how many steps of this type are stuck without a builder to run on.

panels.title: Time since a platform last ran a step
panels.description: How long since anything of this system type last ran. Only reported while nothing of the type is running. (machineTypes.*.lastActive, classic runner only)

panels.title: Build time consumed per jobset
panels.description: Builder time each jobset has used in the current scheduling window. (jobsets.*.seconds)

panels.title: Scheduling shares used per jobset
panels.description: Hydra's fair-share accounting. A jobset far above the others has been taking more than its share, so its steps get scheduled last. (jobsets.*.shareUsed)

panels.title: narinfo cache hit rate
panels.description: Share of store-path lookups answered from memory instead of the binary cache. A low rate means a lot of avoidable cache requests. (narInfoReadAverted)

panels.title: Path info cache size
panels.description: Store-path entries the runner is holding in memory. (narInfoCacheSize)

panels.title: NAR compression savings
panels.description: Share of bytes saved by compressing store paths before upload. (narCompressionSavings)

panels.title: NAR compression speed
panels.description: Throughput of the compressor while packing store paths. (narCompressionSpeed)

panels.title: narinfo lookups
panels.description: The runner's metadata traffic: lookups fetched, answered from memory, not found, and written back. (store.narInfo*)

panels.title: NAR throughput
panels.description: Store-path bytes moved per second, before and after compression. The compressed lines are what actually crosses the network. (store.nar*Bytes)

panels.title: NAR operations
panels.description: Store paths read and written per minute. Averted writes are uploads skipped because the path was already in the cache. (store.narRead, narWrite, narWriteAverted)

panels.title: Time spent compressing NARs
panels.description: Seconds spent compressing per second of wall-clock. Near 1 means a full core is busy compressing. (narWriteCompressionTimeMs)

panels.title: Dispatcher
panels.description: How often the scheduler wakes up, and the share of its time it spends handing steps to builders.

panels.title: Dispatcher latency
panels.description: Average time one scheduling pass takes. Grows with the size of the queue.

panels.title: Queue monitor wakeups
panels.description: How often the runner re-reads the queue from the database. (nrQueueWakeups, classic runner only)

panels.title: Database
panels.description: Open database connections and updates in flight. (nrDbConnections, nrActiveDbUpdates, classic runner only)

panels.title: Build data transfer
panels.description: Build inputs sent out to builders and results copied back. (bytesSent, bytesReceived, classic runner only)

panels.title: Queue runner uptime
panels.description: Time since the queue runner started. A drop to zero here explains every counter on the dashboard resetting. (uptime)

panels.title: Status age
panels.description: Age of the last status dump Hydra produced. If this keeps growing the scrape is failing, and the queue is not simply quiet. (time)
